$comment: Requirement leaves specified but not yet executable. A burn-down list tracked by https://github.com/missingbulb/WIP/issues/6 — it only shrinks. A leaf listed here must carry the loud TBD marker on its line in requirements.md, and must have no case; the coverage gate enforces both directions.

leaves.reason: The screen kind's renderer cannot flatten a UIKit-backed control, so no golden can show the standard switch; a lookalike drawn in SwiftUI would pass the golden while breaking the requirement. Needs a kind that drives the real control.
Needs a real device or a faithful audio-session fake; neither exists yet. Claimed by a behavior case once Capture ships its fake session.
